name: Scorecard
description: Shows the public OpenSSF Scorecard of a repo's GitHub remote: the score, which checks lose points, and a one-tap prompt for the agent to fix one. It reads only the public Scorecard and GitHub APIs (no sign-in, no model call) and only when you look. The repo's owner/name goes to api.github.com to check it is public; a private repo's name is never sent to OpenSSF.
